items.title: Spain threatens retaliation if Italy fails to lift border controls after Ceuta crossings
items.dek: Italy has said it will not accept "ultimatums or impositions" after the mass crossing of migrants from Morocco to Ceuta last week.

items.title: Mexico and Peru restore diplomatic relations after asylum row
items.dek: Relations broke down after former Peruvian Prime Minister Betssy Chávez sought asylum in the Mexican embassy in November 2025.
